title: Offline Policy Evaluation Lab
dek: Counterledger is an offline policy evaluator I built in Python: it estimates how a new decision policy (the target) would have done from records of past decisions (the logger), without trying it for real. This page rebuilds its importance-sampling core and puts an apparent gain through four checks.
summary: A new decision policy looks 0.27 better on records of past decisions, but a control that ignores the situation gets 65% of that, and a changed reward erases it.
